THE BIG PICTURE

Abstract

Forecasting with patterns,
context, and reasoning.

Real-world forecasts depend on more than historical patterns.

This tutorial explores advances in context-aware time series forecasting with large language models, moving beyond historical pattern recognition toward context-grounded cognitive reasoning. It explains why real-world forecasts depend not only on temporal patterns, but also on external environments, events, domain knowledge, and system states.

The tutorial introduces three generations of context intelligence: multimodal semantic understanding, slow-thinking reasoning over predictive evidence, and agentic interaction with tools and environments. It shows how these capabilities support interpretation, reasoning, and information acquisition, with representative applications in electricity load forecasting, renewable power generation, traffic, industry, and scientific forecasting, while highlighting open challenges and future directions.
